subject: Air freight quote: MUC to PVG
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from MUC to PVG (Shanghai, CN)?

We will deliver the shipment to MUC ourselves. It will be ready on 2026-11-28. The shipment consists of 1 piece of furniture samples, with a gross weight of 1027.36 lb and a volume of 129.96 cubic feet.

Please let me know the earliest departure and arrival you can offer, together with your all-in price in EUR.

Thank you.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a shipment from MUC to PVG.
